The Renato Cintra Arquitectos studio, led by the architect Renato Cintra, was created in 2005 and the brand has been asserting itself since then, continuing to dedicate itself to architecture, coordination and supervision of works. Its intervention is mainly focused on residential architecture, with projects from scratch or requalifications, in the private segment. In addition, the portfolio integrates corporate projects and public spaces.
